stable.notes: Characters 301 and a bigger, smoother session pet. Miles Windu is now a searchable bundled animated character in the Pet gallery alongside 300 OpenPets options. Character scale defaults to 300%, reaches 600%, and migrates an existing 300% maximum once. Combat strips advance frame by frame, ambient playback reserves saber-draw clips for real signals, and repaired duel, patrol, and sprint artwork removes ghosting, displaced figures, spillover, and white paper pockets. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
